mainEntity.name: What should I ask a contractor before signing a commercial construction contract?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask about similar project experience, schedule, staffing, permit handling, insurance, change-order procedures, and warranty support. You should also confirm how they will manage disruptions to tenants, employees, or customers if the work happens in an occupied space.
